## 4. Fixed canon and open space

The Teacher gives the child a yellow pencil marked with his name on tape. He writes his name four times, then the word for water, closes the book, and hides the pencil in his sock despite being told nobody will take it. Do not explain the habit or add what he writes next. Candidate language may add an image, rhythm, or private impression as an editorial draft, but no proposed addition becomes a further remembered event or a confirmed fact until the existing content owner selects and reviews it against the source.

Keep the pencil yellow, the name on tape, and the private act of hiding it. The prose may notice what the author can count, hear, repair, fear, or leave uncertain, while keeping the account’s limits visible.
